title: Characterizing Cross-Relay Generalization Failure in Machine Learning-Based Power System Protection
abstract: arXiv:2610.28348v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning-based fault detectors are often evaluated at the relay locations used for training, although local voltage and current measurements vary across power networks. This work investigates cross-relay generalization for binary detection of faults anywhere in the network using local measurements, rather than line-selective tripping. Using 50 ms windows from a simulated 110 kV transmission network, we evaluate a multilayer perceptron across all 64 source target combinations of eight relays and five random seeds. A shared simulation-level split and source-only threshold selection provide a controlled held-out evaluation without target-specific calibration. Despite nearly unchanged mean F1-scores (0.730 within-relay versus 0.734 cross-relay), the mean false-positive rate (FPR) increases from 0.088 to 0.341, while the mean false-negative rate decreases from 0.399 to 0.318. The change is strongly directional: models trained at Bus 2

translated_title: 基于机器学习的电力系统保护中跨继电器泛化失效的表征分析
translated_abstract: 基于机器学习的故障检测器通常在训练所用的继电器位置上进行评估，然而电力网络中各继电器位置的局部电压和电流测量值存在差异。本工作研究了基于局部测量、对网络中任意位置故障进行二元检测（而非线路选择性跳闸）的跨继电器泛化问题。利用从模拟110 kV输电网络中提取的50毫秒时间窗口数据，我们在8个继电器和5个随机种子的全部64种源-目标组合上评估了多层感知机。通过共享的仿真级数据划分和仅基于源数据的阈值选择，实现了无需目标侧校准的受控留出评估。尽管平均F1分数几乎保持不变（继电器内为0.730，跨继电器为0.734），平均误报率（FPR）却从0.088升至0.341，而平均漏报率从0.399降至0.318。这种变化呈现出强烈的方向性：在母线2（Bus 2）训练的模型……
tldr: 该研究揭示了基于机器学习的故障检测器在跨继电器部署时存在方向性泛化失效——虽然平均F1分数几乎不变，但误报率从0.088激增至0.341，说明仅依靠平均指标评估会掩盖部署中严重的可靠性劣化问题。
en_tdlr: This work reveals a directional cross-relay generalization failure in ML-based fault detection: while mean F1-scores remain nearly unchanged, false-positive rates surge from 0.088 to 0.341, showing that average metrics can mask severe reliability degradation when models are deployed across different relays.
